Jules (Marketing): Proposal: a 22-minute "Mini Accelerator" — short demo, benchmark snapshot, and a 75-credit experiment to prime product-led activation. Target: users who visited the prompt gallery last 30 days.
Arman (Growth): Love the focused list. Keep CTAs razor: "Run this prompt" + "Save to your library". Suggest split credits: 25 on signup, 50 after checklist to deter abuse.
Keiko (Product): We can preload 3 gallery prompts in the console during the session and show estimated tokens + latency inline. That benchmark will help set realistic expectations.
Tori (Onboarding): Checklist suggestion: 1) create API key, 2) run one preloaded prompt, 3) save prompt to library. Unlock the 50 on completion. I'll draft copy.
Samir (Ops): Routing: route demo sessions to `mini-accel-pool` with fallback to hosted. Add per-org cap of 3 and expiry 30d. Quick pseudo-config so infra knows: pool=mini-accel-pool, qps=65, fallback=hosted-std.
Jules (Marketing): Landing headline draft: "Mini Accelerator: Ship an LLM demo in 22 minutes + 75 credits". Supporting line: "Live prompts, cost & latency benchmarks, and plug-and-play templates." Keep it concise.
Arman (Growth): Experiment arms: A) 75 upfront, B) 25 + 50 gated, holdout 30%. Metrics: landing CVR, attendance %, first API call within 24h, prompt-save rate, day7 retention, promo credit consumption.
Keiko (Product): We'll instrument per-prompt telemetry and include a tiny benchmark table in the follow-up email: median latency, avg tokens, and typical cost per run.
Tori (Onboarding): UI: show a progress modal and credit balance after unlock. Visible credits reduce confusion. Keiko, can you own modal UX?
Keiko (Product): Yup — will mock a tiny modal and confetti state. Tori, send final checklist copy by EOD.
Samir (Ops): Note: add guard to target accounts created within last 90 days or accounts that visited the prompt gallery in the last 30 days. That should limit abuse.
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Mini Accelerator: 22m demo + credits" on 2026-04-20 17:00 UTC. Attendees: Jules, Arman, Keiko, Samir, Tori.
Jules (Marketing): Action items: Jules = landing + promo, Arman = experiment wiring, Keiko = modal + telemetry, Tori = checklist + onboarding flow, Samir = route + policy. I'll drop the landing draft link shortly. Thanks team :sparkles:
